scope: Every nontrivial incomplete prefix of7 previously learned email addresses; quoted local whitespace and internal at-sign

findings.evidence: Quoted local whitespace causes completion to lose the full span even though whole-prefix recall can find the exact saved address. Some domain prefixes recover via a constructed suffix candidate; modeled resulting full text remains correct.
findings.cause: Completion starts at last whitespace except phone-specific scanning; quoted email span is not recognized.

findings.evidence: 5 exact prefixes of uppercase First@Last local part fail whole recall; matching lowercase first@last control has zero misses. The complete stored addresses remain exact and survive JSON reload.
findings.cause: technicalSearchKey uses last at-sign without quoted-local parse state and lowercases following characters as a domain before the actual outer separator is typed.

controls: Plain dev@example.com and quoted-dot First.Last local part have zero missing completions.
Lowercase quoted first@last control isolates the partial case-folding issue.
Full observed storage validated before every prefix sweep.
limits: Core provider and modeled prefix replacement, no native UI test.
Missing offers, not demonstrated automatic rewriting or loss of stored full address.
Whitespace symptom extends technical span-boundary coverage limitations; do not count each prefix as an independent bug.
Production code unchanged; no new device install.
